purpose: Discuss a rumor; teach どうやら/それにしても/だれ/すら/それほど/単なる/奴/ベスト

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Hey, did you hear that rumor?
lines.style: gossipy friend leaning in, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: どうやら本当らしいね。
lines.style: intrigued teen confirming, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それにしても、広まるの早すぎ。
lines.en: Even so, it spread way too fast.
lines.style: amazed friend marveling, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: だれが言い出したんだろう。
lines.style: curious teen questioning the origin, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本人すら知らないうちに、有名になってた。
lines.en: They got famous before even they knew.
lines.style: amused friend recounting irony, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも、それほど大したことじゃないよね。
lines.en: But it’s not that big a deal, right?
lines.style: measured teen downplaying, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 単なる勘違いかもしれないし。
lines.en: It might just be a misunderstanding.
lines.style: cautious friend hedging, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 言い出した奴に直接聞くのがベストだね。
lines.en: Asking the guy who started it directly is best.
lines.style: decisive teen proposing a solution, tone holding steady through the whole line
